name: tilted_tilted
statement: Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) (g : α → ℝ) : (μ.tilted f).tilted g = μ.tilted (f + g)

name: integrable_tilted_iff
statement: Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] {f : α → ℝ} (hf : Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) (g : α → E) : Integrable g (μ.tilted f) ↔ Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x) • g x) μ

name: log_rnDeriv_tilted_left_self
statement: Integrable (fun x ↦ exp (f x)) μ) : (fun x ↦ log ((μ.tilted f).rnDeriv μ x).toReal) =ᵐ[μ] fun x ↦ f x - log (∫ x, exp (f x) ∂μ)
